```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

## get sample names
```{r cars}
fastq.dir <- "/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/mitox/ultra-filtering/data/bowties/"
all.files <- list.files(fastq.dir)
snames <- gsub(".sam", "", all.files)
```

submit test with sbatch --array=0 samtools.sh
submit with sbatch --array=1-140%30 samtools.sh to run the rest of the samples, 30 at a time 

```{r}
fileOut<-file(paste0("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/mitox/ultra-filtering/batch/samtools.sh"))
 
writeLines(c("#!/bin/bash",
               "#SBATCH --job-name=mitox-uf-samtools",
               "#SBATCH --account=PAS1695",
               "#SBATCH --time=24:00:00",
               '#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=28', 
               "",
               
               #List sample names in a way that can be indexed
               paste0("snames=('", paste(snames, collapse = "' '"), "')"),
             
               "",
               "module load samtools/1.21",
               "",
          
               "samtools fastq -f 4 /fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/mitox/ultra-filtering/data/bowties/${snames[$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID]}.sam > /fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/mitox/ultra-filtering/data/ultra-filtered/${snames[$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID]}.fastq 2> /fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/mitox/ultra-filtering/logs/samtools-sam2fastq-${snames[$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID]}.log"
               
  ),
  
  fileOut
  )
```
